# ENDUR trades: trade (TRD)

A booked trade as its source system (ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX) extracts it in the common schema: the deal, its legs with their cash flows and resets, and its events. One row per trade per business date, keyed by TRADE_ID. Read by the **trading** pack's connector `trade-endur` (table `<root>/trading/trade_endur/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (4,407 records); each later day's file holds only the records new or changed that day (108–164 a day). Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 12,477 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/trades/endur/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `TRADE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | `TRADE_ID`, `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `PRODUCT_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_GROUP`, `TRADE_STATUS`, `TRADE_VERSION`, `BUY_SELL_CODE`, `CURRENCY`, `QUANTITY`, `TRADE_DATE`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `PORTFOLIO`, `TRADER_ID`, `NOTIONAL`, `INDEX_NAME` |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date`, `PRODUCT_TYPE` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Sub-types

The rows come in 5 sub-types, recognised by `PRODUCT_TYPE`. Each has its own most complete record below; the fields every sub-type's record has are in one shared table first.

| Sub-type | Recognised by | Rows | Sample from | Section |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **ComSwap** | `PRODUCT_TYPE` `ComSwap` | 5,655 | test data | [ComSwap](#comswap) |
| **ComFut** | `PRODUCT_TYPE` `ComFut` | 2,456 | test data | [ComFut](#comfut) |
| **Commodity** | `PRODUCT_TYPE` `Commodity` | 2,140 | test data | [Commodity](#commodity) |
| **Cash** | `PRODUCT_TYPE` `Cash` | 2,075 | test data | [Cash](#cash) |
| **CallNot** | `PRODUCT_TYPE` `CallNot` | 151 | test data | [CallNot](#callnot) |

## Fields every sub-type has

The example is from the **ComSwap** record.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE_SYSTEM` | string | required | The booking system the trade comes from: ENDUR, CALYPSO or MUREX (upper case). | one of `CALYPSO`, `ENDUR`, `MUREX` | `"ENDUR"` |
| `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in 60% of rows) | When the booking system last changed the trade, ISO-8601 UTC; moves with every amendment (empty on an ENDUR trade never amended). | — | `"2026-07-20T17:13:00Z"` |
| `TRADE_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The date the trade was agreed. | — | `"2025-09-01"` |
| `TRADE_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | links to `trade` | `"1005000"` |
| `TRADE_STATUS` | string | required | Life-cycle status: NEW, VALIDATED, AMENDED, MATURED or CANCELLED. A cancellation is a new version with CANCELLED, never a deleted row; VaR counts only live statuses. | one of `AMENDED`, `CANCELLED`, `MATURED`, `NEW`, `VALIDATED` | `"VALIDATED"` |
| `TRADE_ACTION` | string | optional (filled in 60% of rows) | The last action on the trade: NEW or AMEND (empty on ENDUR when none). | one of `AMEND`, `NEW` | `"AMEND"` |
| `TRADE_VERSION` | string | optional (filled in 88% of rows) | The booking system's version of the trade, as text; it goes up by one with every amendment (empty when the system gives none). | — | `"3"` |
| `TRANSACTION_ID` | string | required | The booking system's number of this version of the trade: it changes with every amendment while TRADE_ID stays. Text. | — | `"700059841"` |
| `QUANTITY` | number | required | The trade's quantity: units of the commodity in the leg's PRICE_UNIT for a commodity trade, else the notional or face amount in CURRENCY. Unsigned: the side is BUY_SELL_CODE. | unit: PRICE_UNIT or CURRENCY | `5400.0` |
| `PRICE` | number | optional (filled in 65% of rows) | The deal's headline price or rate as booked. ENDUR: the fixed price per the leg's PRICE_UNIT; CALYPSO and MUREX: the first of the product's clean price, trade price, forward price, fixed price, fixed rate, coupon, rate, repo rate, spread or premium (a rate as a fraction, 0.042 is 4.2%; a price in the product's quote); null when the product has none. | — | `94.2063` |
| `BUY_SELL_CODE` | string | required | The bank's side: B (bought, pays fixed, buys protection) or S (sold). | one of `B`, `S` | `"S"` |
| `PRODUCT_TYPE` | string | required | The product type as the booking system types it; it selects the trade's Sutra. ENDUR: ComSwap, ComFut, Cash, CallNot, Commodity; CALYPSO and MUREX: the product taxonomy code (FRA, SWAPTION_BERM, EQ_TRS, CMD_APO,...). | seen: `ComSwap`, `ComFut`, `Commodity`, `Cash`, `CallNot` | `"ComSwap"` |
| `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE` | string | required | The finer type: ENDUR its sub-type code (ENGY-SWAP, ENGY-B-SWAP, ENGY-EXCH-FUT, CASH, NOSTRO, NGX-COMM-PHYS, COMM-WARRANTS-INV); CALYPSO and MUREX the product's name (Basis swap (float/float)). | seen: `ENGY-SWAP`, `ENGY-EXCH-FUT`, `CASH`, `NGX-COMM-PHYS`, `COMM-WARRANTS-INV`, `ENGY-B-SWAP`, `NOSTRO` | `"ENGY-SWAP"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | string | required | The trade's counterparty: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…). | pattern `^CP-`; links to `counterparty` | `"CP-NORTHPLAINS"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY_UEN` | string | required | The counterparty's unique entity number in the bank's client master (UENnnnnnnn). | — | `"UEN0100888"` |
| `COUNTERPARTY_COUNTRY_OF_RISK` | string | required | The counterparty's country of risk, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. | — | `"CA"` |
| `ORIGINAL_COUNTERPARTY` | string | optional (filled in 10% of rows) | The counterparty before a novation: a COUNTERPARTY_ID of the core pack's counterparty kind (CP-…); empty when the trade was not novated. | pattern `^CP-`; links to `counterparty` | `"CP-RHEINTAL"` |
| `ORIGINAL_COUNTERPARTY_UEN` | string | optional (filled in 10% of rows) | The original counterparty's unique entity number, when the trade was novated; empty otherwise. | — | `"UEN0100518"` |
| `INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_CODE` | string | required | External for a trade with a client or market counterparty; Portfolio (ENDUR's internal code) for one between two of the bank's books. | one of `External`, `Portfolio` | `"External"` |
| `TRANSIT` | string | required | The bank's branch transit number of the booking legal entity: five digits, text, leading zeros kept. | one of `00107`, `00214`, `00321`, `00428` | `"00107"` |
| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | string | required | The bank's legal entity that booked the trade: an ENTITY_ID of the core pack's legal-entity kind (LE-…). | pattern `^LE-`; links to `legal-entity` | `"LE-NY"` |
| `PORTFOLIO` | string | required | The book the trade is booked in: a BOOK_ID of the core pack's book kind (BOOK-…). | pattern `^BOOK-`; links to `book` | `"BOOK-COMM-2"` |
| `TRADER_ID` | string | required | The trader who booked it: a TRADER_ID of the core pack's trader kind (TRDR-…). | pattern `^TRDR-`; links to `trader` | `"TRDR-FROSSI"` |
| `TRADER_FIRST_NAME` | string | required | The trader's first name or initial, as the booking system keeps it. | seen: `T.`, `F.` | `"F."` |
| `TRADER_LAST_NAME` | string | required | The trader's last name, as the booking system keeps it. | seen: `Brennan`, `Rossi` | `"Rossi"` |
| `START_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The trade's start (effective) date. | — | `"2025-11-01"` |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The trade's final maturity (last payment or expiry) date. | — | `"2026-10-31"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The trade's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"EUR"` |
| `DELIVERY_VERSUS_PAYMENT` | string | required | YES when the instrument and the cash change hands together (securities), else NO. | one of `NO`, `YES` | `"YES"` |
| `LEGS` | array of objects | required | The trade's legs, in LEG_ID order: one object per leg (a swap has two, a future or a cash deal one). | — | [2 objects] |
| `LEGS[].LEG_ID` | string | required | The leg's number within the trade (1, 2,...), text; EVENTS[].LEG_ID names it. | — | `"1"` |
| `LEGS[].LEG_TYPE` | string | required | FIXED, FLOAT (set by an index), OPTION or PHYSICAL. | one of `FIXED`, `FLOAT`, `OPTION`, `PHYSICAL` | `"FIXED"` |
| `LEGS[].CURRENCY` | string | required | The leg's currency, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"EUR"` |
| `LEGS[].NOTIONAL` | number | required | The leg's amount: quantity times price for a commodity leg, the principal for a rates leg, in the leg's CURRENCY. | unit: leg currency | `508714.02` |
| `LEGS[].SETTLEMENT_TYPE` | string | required | Cash Settlement or Physical Settlement. | one of `Cash Settlement`, `Physical Settlement` | `"Cash Settlement"` |
| `LEGS[].DAILY_VOLUME` | string | optional (filled in 82% of `LEGS[]` entries) | ENDUR: the leg's quantity per day, in PRICE_UNIT, as text; empty otherwise. | unit: PRICE_UNIT per day | `"23"` |
| `LEGS[].INDEX` | object | required | The leg's floating index: NAME, GROUP and SUB_GROUP, each empty on a fixed leg. | — | {…} |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS` | array of objects | required | The leg's periods: each with its dates, notional, rate or price, and its resets. | — | [12 objects] |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].FLOW_ID` | string | required | The flow's number in the booking system, unique within the system; text. | — | `"5131085"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].NOTIONAL` | number | required | The flow's notional (for a commodity flow its quantity times price), in the leg's currency. | unit: leg currency | `42392.83` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].START_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The first day of the flow's accrual or pricing period. | — | `"2025-11-01"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].END_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The last day of the flow's accrual or pricing period. | — | `"2025-11-30"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].PAYMENT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The day the flow is paid. | — | `"2025-12-07"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].RATE_DETERMINATION_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[]` entry) | The day the flow's floating rate or price is determined (its fixing date); empty when not given. | — | `"2025-11-30"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].FIRST_RESET_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in every `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[]` entry) | The first day the flow's floating price or rate is observed (its first RESETS[].RESET_DATE); empty for a fixed flow. | — | `"2025-11-01"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].STRIKE_PRICE` | number | required | The flow's strike or fixed price (an option's strike rate; ENDUR a fixed leg's price); 0.0 when none. | — | `94.2063` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].RESETS` | array of objects | required (filled in 61% of `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[]` entries) | The flow's fixings: one object per reset (observation) date in date order; an empty array for a fixed flow. | — | [20 objects] |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].RESETS[].START_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The first day the reset applies to. | — | `"2025-11-03"` |
| `LEGS[].CASH_FLOWS[].RESETS[].END_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The last day the reset applies to. | — | `"2025-11-03"` |
| `EVENTS` | array of objects | required (filled in 89% of rows) | The trade's life-cycle and cash events, in EVENT_NUMBER order: one object per event (an empty array when none). | — | [24 objects] |
| `EVENTS[].LEG_ID` | string | optional (filled in every `EVENTS[]` entry) | The leg the event belongs to (a LEGS[].LEG_ID); empty for a deal-level event (BOOKED, CONFIRMED, MATURITY...). | — | `"1"` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_ID` | string | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The event's number in the booking system; text. | — | `"9036460"` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_NUMBER` | integer | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The event's position among the trade's events (1, 2,...). | — | `1` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_TYPE` | string | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | What happened or will: CASH_SETTLEMENT, FEE, RESET, AMENDMENT, NOVATION (ENDUR), BOOKED, CONFIRMED, CLEARED, AMENDED, CASH_SETTLED, NEXT_PAYMENT, PARTIALLY_TERMINATED, MATURITY (CALYPSO, MUREX); may be empty on ENDUR. | seen: `CASH_SETTLEMENT`, `FEE`, `NOVATION`, `AMENDMENT`, `RESET` | `"CASH_SETTLEMENT"` |
| `EVENTS[].PAYMENT_TYPE` | string | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | What a cash event pays (Interest, Premium, Commodity payment, Fee, Amendment fee, Novation fee, Fixing, Adjustment, Futures settlement, Cash payment, Caplet,... or the accrual period START..END); empty for a non-cash event. | — | `"Commodity payment"` |
| `EVENTS[].EVENT_DATE` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The day of the event; for a cash event the day the cash moves. | — | `"2025-12-07"` |
| `EVENTS[].AMOUNT` | number | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The event's cash amount from the bank's side, in EVENTS[].CURRENCY: negative is paid, positive received; empty for a non-cash event. | unit: event currency | `47103.15` |
| `EVENTS[].CURRENCY` | string | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The currency of the event's amount, ISO 4217. | one of `AUD`, `CAD`, `CHF`, `EUR`, `GBP`, `JPY`, `USD` | `"EUR"` |
| `EVENTS[].SEQUENCE_NUMBER` | integer | optional (filled in 95% of `EVENTS[]` entries) | The event's order in the booking system (equal to EVENT_NUMBER in the test data). | — | `1` |

## One record of each sub-type

Each record is real, the most complete of its sub-type, pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data. Below each record, the fields it has beyond the shared table.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `TRADE_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SOURCE_SYSTEM`, `TRADE_DATE`, `TRADE_ID`, `TRADE_STATUS`, `TRANSACTION_ID`, `QUANTITY`, `BUY_SELL_CODE`, `PRODUCT_TYPE`, `PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE`, `COUNTERPARTY`, `COUNTERPARTY_UEN`, `COUNTERPARTY_COUNTRY_OF_RISK`, `INTERNAL_EXTERNAL_CODE`, `TRANSIT`, `LEGAL_ENTITY`, `PORTFOLIO`, `TRADER_ID`, `TRADER_FIRST_NAME`, `TRADER_LAST_NAME`, `START_DATE`, `MATURITY_DATE`, `CURRENCY`, `DELIVERY_VERSUS_PAYMENT`, `LEGS`, `EVENTS` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- `TRADE_ID` is text, unique across the source systems; a JSON number is read as text, leading zeros kept.
- Every day sends the trades new or changed that day (or the whole book): an amendment is the whole trade again with `TRADE_VERSION` raised, `TRADE_ACTION` and `TRANSACTION_ID` new and `SOURCE_UPDATE_TIME` later; a cancellation is the trade again with `TRADE_STATUS` `CANCELLED`. A trade is never deleted from the files.
- Missing values may be spelt `""` as the extracts do; the screens read them with `nonblank`.
- `EVENTS[].AMOUNT` is signed: paid negative, received positive.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `TRADE_ID` per business_date.
